description.value: Basil Garden Pho is a family-run Vietnamese restaurant on East Broadway in Vancouver, known for its pho broth simmered for over 18 hours using fresh, carefully chosen ingredients. The menu ranges from classic beef and pork bone noodle soups to appetizers, rice dishes, and salad bowls, with vegetarian options available. It offers a relaxed, home-cooked atmosphere that would suit a cyclist looking for a filling, authentic meal.
